title: Green Account (checking) at a glance
summary: This document summarizes the Green Account (checking): $22.50 monthly maintenance fee waived with a $1,350 minimum daily balance; 0.11% APY; no overdraft fees/coverage (declines transactions over balance); and direct deposits up to 1 day early. It lists $3,000/day mobile check deposits, $2.50 monthly paper statement fee, $3.00 out-of-network ATM fee, $17.50 returned deposit fee, and $15.00 incoming domestic wire (receive). It also covers savings APY boosts (+0.75% Gold, +0.25% Silver) and a referral program ($20 per referrer; $30 welcome bonus; max 5 referrals/year; $500 deposit within 60 days; 30-day tenure).
